note: The weekly plan allowance, in plan units, that hooks/lib/session-budget.mjs quotes as a percentage in the session budget notice. A plan unit is a token count priced at the Sonnet 5 rates (the tier config/model-tiers.json planUsageMultipliers defines as 1.0) times the model's tier multiplier; see scripts/lib/pricing.mjs planPriceSpecFor. The figure is the operator's own reading, not a published limit: the usage postmortem of 2026-09-25..2026-10-02 put hits at about 2,650-2,900 units and the 2026-10-02 in-app reading at 1,700-2,200, so ~1,900 is the working number. Edit it here when the limit moves; it only changes the percentage in the notice, never when the notice fires (that is the session_budget_units option).
